t: What is the difference between “buy” and “bought”? - Quora
s: Answer (1 of 7): “Buy” is the present indefinite tense of the verb while “bought” is the past tense of the verb. For example: I buy oranges. (that it is a habit) I will buy oranges. (intention/wish) He bought the oranges. (that the action has been done already)
